criticality_levels.CRITICAL: Automatic skill failure on Prometric exam if missed. Represents direct patient safety risk. Maps to HHSC-designated critical safety steps.
criticality_levels.MAJOR: Significant point deduction (typically 5–8 points). Does not trigger automatic failure but indicates a serious competency gap.
criticality_levels.MINOR: Small deduction (1–3 points). Technique or communication issue with limited safety impact.

hand_hygiene_ppe.title: Hand Hygiene & PPE Donning/Doffing
hand_hygiene_ppe.texas_2024_section: Section IV — Infection Prevention and Control

step_01.title: Hand hygiene before resident contact
step_01.exam_notes: Automatic failure if omitted at start of any skill.

step_02.title: Correct handwashing technique (20 sec)
step_02.exam_notes: 20-sec minimum, all surfaces, rinse wrist→fingertips, towel for faucet.

step_03.title: Select correct PPE for care type
step_03.curriculum_topic: PPE Selection — Contact vs Droplet vs Airborne
step_03.exam_notes: Contact precautions require gown + gloves minimum.

step_04.title: Don PPE in correct CDC order
step_04.exam_notes: Gloves LAST overlapping gown cuffs. Examiner verifies sequence.

step_05.title: Doff PPE safely
step_05.exam_notes: Gloves first (most contaminated), gown rolled inward, mask last.

step_06.title: Hand hygiene after PPE removal
step_06.exam_notes: Independent critical step — explicitly on Prometric checklist.

transfer_bed_wheelchair.title: Safe Transfer: Bed to Wheelchair
transfer_bed_wheelchair.texas_2024_section: Section V — Safety and Emergency Procedures; Section IX — Basic Restorative Services

step_01.title: Hand hygiene and transfer plan review
step_01.exam_notes: Hand hygiene before any resident contact.

step_02.title: Environment preparation — full setup
step_02.curriculum_topic: Wheelchair Positioning, Locks, and Bed Height
step_02.exam_notes: Stronger-side positioning, 45°, both locks, footrests cleared, correct bed height.

step_03.title: Explain procedure and assist to seated edge
step_03.exam_notes: Seated balance pause prevents orthostatic hypotension.

step_04.title: Gait belt application
step_04.exam_notes: Over clothing, waist level, buckle not at spine, 2-finger test, underhand grip.

step_05.title: Stand-pivot transfer with body mechanics
step_05.curriculum_topic: Stand-Pivot Technique and CNA Body Mechanics
step_05.exam_notes: Knee-block, verbal count-in, bend knees not waist, pivot feet not spine.

step_06.title: Post-transfer positioning and completion
step_06.exam_notes: Footrests replaced, gait belt removed, fully seated, hand hygiene.

comm_01.curriculum_topic: Pre-Procedure Explanation, Pain Assessment, and Verbal Count-In

comm_02.curriculum_topic: Post-Transfer Encouragement, Comfort Check, and Documentation

vital_signs_documentation.title: Vital Signs & Documentation
vital_signs_documentation.prometric_skill_title: Oral Temperature; Pulse and Respirations; Blood Pressure (Manual)
vital_signs_documentation.texas_2024_section: Section VI — Basic Nursing Skills; Section III — Communication and Documentation

step_01.title: Hand hygiene and two-identifier verification
step_01.exam_notes: Open-ended name + DOB/wristband. Room number NOT acceptable.

step_02.title: Oral temperature — electronic
step_02.exam_notes: Probe cover, sublingual pocket, lips closed, wait for device signal.

step_03.title: Radial pulse — rate, rhythm, quality
step_03.exam_notes: Index + middle fingers (no thumb), 60-sec count, three characteristics.

step_04.title: Respirations — covert count, 60 seconds
step_04.exam_notes: Covert transition from pulse, complete rise+fall=1, 60 sec.

step_05.title: BP preparation — arm selection and cuff
step_05.curriculum_topic: BP — Arm Contraindications and Cuff Placement
step_05.exam_notes: No IV arm, 1-2 inches above antecubital, artery marker aligned, snug.

step_06.title: BP auscultation — Korotkoff technique
step_06.curriculum_topic: Manual BP — Palpatory Estimation and Auscultation
step_06.exam_notes: Palpatory step, 2-3 mmHg/sec deflation, record both values with units.

step_07.title: Interpret findings and report abnormals
step_07.curriculum_topic: Recognizing Abnormals and Immediate Nurse Notification
step_07.exam_notes: Compare to care-plan thresholds. CNA scope: measure, document, REPORT.

step_08.title: Accurate, complete, timely documentation
step_08.exam_notes: All 4 values + units + time + nurse notification noted + CNA signature.
